# Best Sneakers Under ₹5,000 in India: Find Your Comet

Two Comet sneaker families come in under ₹5,000: X Lows from ₹4,299 and Aeon V2 from ₹4,499. Use the picker to match your budget, where you will wear them and your style.

Prices checked on wearcomet.com on 21 Nov 2026.

## What to check in any sneaker under ₹5,000

### Sole
Look for a rubber outsole and a cushioned midsole. X Lows list natural rubber and an EVA insert inside Comet's SpaceWalk 3-layer sole (insole, cushioned EVA insert, natural rubber outsole).

### Toe box and fit
X Lows have a roomy toe box with Oxford construction made for broad Indian feet. Sizes run UK 3 to 12 with a size chart on each product page, and women are advised to size down one.

### Materials and care
X Lows use faux leather and faux suede (Cortado uses canvas with a microfiber underlay). Keep suede parts away from water, and wipe rather than scrub.

### Returns
Free shipping across India (usually dispatched within 24 hours, delivery in 3 to 5 days) and free returns and exchanges for 7 days from delivery, so you can test the fit.

Do not just take any brand's word for it. Read owner threads on r/SneakersIndia too.

## When Comet is not the right pick

If your cap is below ₹4,299, Comet is not the answer. Comet is not the cheapest sneaker brand. Suede parts also need keeping dry.

If ₹4,299 works, start with X Lows.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Comet?
Comet is an Indian sneaker brand based in Bengaluru that sells online at wearcomet.com. Its collections are X Lows, Aeres, Apex and Aeon V2, plus Astra for women. This guide is about the sneaker brand, not the object in space.

### What are the best sneakers for college guys?
There is no single best pair, but for lectures and walking, pick a low-top you can wear all day. Comet's X Lows start at ₹4,299 and have a roomy toe box and a cushioned SpaceWalk sole. Use the picker above to filter by budget and style.

### What kind of shoes do college students wear?
Mostly low-top sneakers in neutral colours that go with jeans and joggers. Comet's X Lows Cortado, Snow and Chestnut are neutral colourways, each ₹4,299 on wearcomet.com.

### What are the Indian sneaker brands?
Comet is a Bengaluru sneaker brand, run by Grails Marketing Private Limited in Koramangala, with pairs from ₹4,299. Several other Indian brands exist, so compare sole, fit, materials and return policy before you pick.

### Which is the cheapest brand of sneakers?
Not Comet. Its lowest price on wearcomet.com is ₹4,299. If your cap is below that, another brand is the honest answer. If you can reach ₹4,299 to ₹4,499, X Lows and Aeon V2 are the two options under ₹5,000.

### What shoes is Gen Z wearing?
Trends move fast, so choose by budget, comfort hours and how it goes with your outfits. For under ₹5,000, Comet offers X Lows (₹4,299) in neutral colourways and Aeon V2 Sourbomb (₹4,499) in a bolder colour.

### Are sneakers under ₹5,000 good quality?
It depends on the pair. Check the sole, upper material, toe room and return policy. Comet's X Lows list a natural rubber outsole and EVA insert. Read owner threads on r/SneakersIndia too, then use the free 7-day returns and exchanges to test the fit.

### Do Comet sneakers fit true to size?
Sizes run UK 3 to 12 with a size chart on each page, and the toe box is roomy. Comet advises women to go one size smaller. If the size is off, returns and exchanges are free for 7 days.

### Are Comet sneakers comfortable for all-day wear?
Comet designs X Lows with a roomy toe box and a 3-layer SpaceWalk sole (insole, cushioned EVA insert, natural rubber outsole) for 9AM-to-9PM wear. Comfort is personal, so check the size chart and use the free 7-day returns and exchanges if the fit is off.

### Which sneakers stay comfortable after 8-10 hours?
Look for a roomy toe box, a cushioned midsole and a grippy rubber outsole, then test the fit at home. Comet's X Lows (₹4,299) list all three, and returns and exchanges are free for 7 days if they do not suit your feet.

### How do I clean Comet sneakers?
Comet's care guide says to clean different materials separately, wipe instead of scrubbing, use a microfiber cloth or soft brush, avoid harsh cleaning liquids and air dry at room temperature. X Lows have suede parts, so keep them away from water.

### Does Comet offer free shipping and returns?
Yes, on wearcomet.com: free shipping across India to serviceable PIN codes, usually dispatched within 24 hours and delivered in 3 to 5 days, plus free returns and exchanges up to 7 days from delivery. Check the live policy page before ordering.

### What sizes does Comet make?
X Lows come in UK 3 to 12. For example, UK 8 fits a 26.5 cm foot on Comet's size chart. Comet advises women to go one size smaller, for example UK 5 instead of UK 6.

### Are Comet sneakers made in India?
Comet is a Bengaluru brand run by Grails Marketing Private Limited. The country of origin is listed per pair and not every listing shows the same country, so check the product page for the pair you want before you buy.

### Does Comet have sneakers for women under ₹5,000?
Comet's women's range on wearcomet.com includes X Lows, Aeres, Astra, Apex and Aeon V2. X Lows are listed from ₹4,299, so check the women's page for the colourway and price you want. Comet advises women to go one size smaller.

### Is Comet worth it compared with a discounted Nike or Puma under ₹5,000?
Not always. Global brands also sell under ₹5,000, and Comet starts at ₹4,299. Compare sole, fit, materials and return terms. Comet's case is a roomy toe box, a SpaceWalk sole and free 7-day returns, so decide with the size chart in hand.

**Quick answer:** For a Sunday café crawl in Mumbai, wear a light canvas low-top you can walk in for hours. Comet's X Lows Cortado (cream canvas, ₹4,299) has a roomy toe box and a cushioned SpaceWalk sole. #### Which sneakers are comfy for walking all day?
Comet's X Lows (₹4,299) have a roomy toe box and a 3-layer SpaceWalk sole that Comet designs for 9AM-to-9PM wear. If the fit is off, returns and exchanges are free for 7 days.

#### High-tops or low-tops for a day out in the city?
For a crawl with lots of walking and getting in and out of cafes, low-tops are the easier pick. Comet's X Lows are low-tops from ₹4,299, in neutral colourways like Cortado and Snow.

#### What sneakers go with a casual weekend outfit?
Neutral low-tops are the safe choice with jeans, shorts or joggers. X Lows Cortado (cream canvas), Snow and Chestnut are ₹4,299 each, and Aeon V2 Sourbomb (₹4,499) adds a colour pop.
